description:
Browse one RS3 catalogue group. Use lookup_item for name search or get_item_details for one item record.

Discover category IDs with get_ge_info view=categories and nonempty letters with view=category_counts. IDs 0 and 42 both say Miscellaneous but are separate groups, not aliases.

For example, {"category":24,"alpha":"#","page":2} requests the second numeric-name page of high-level melee weapons. Pass a literal #, not %23; the server encodes it. When changing category or alpha, restart page at 1 rather than continuing the old sequence.

Jagex total counts the category, not the letter. Stop on empty items; isError means failure, not completion. Guide prices lag activity.

Each call makes one uncached public Jagex read. No credentials required; HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute. Honor 429 Retry-After.

alpha.description: Starting letter (a-z) or # for numbers. Defaults to "a".

name: browse_items
title: Browse Catalogue Items
